en.headline:
Explore a style.
Make a new one.
en.intro: Choose visual anchors, reflect on their connections, and turn your response into a living p5.js artwork.
en.hero_caption: The current archive, with three real style previews selected.
en.concept_title: An archive you can interact with.
en.concept: The archive is a collection of small programmed sketches, not a gallery of fixed images. Hover over a style to reveal its moving preview. Select one, two or three that catch your attention.
features: Each entry pairs a style name with visual tags. Your selected names and tags become the starting material for the next stage.
OpenAI returns a poetic aesthetic archetype, a short interpretation and a follow-up question. This is a creative prompt, not a psychological assessment.
Your response and selected styles are used to request three p5.js works: a pure generative sketch, a camera-reactive work and an audio-reactive work.
en.demo_intro: An anchor is simply a style you select. Try the three examples below to see the actual labels and visual tags the app uses.
en.demo_note: This small selection demo reuses real archive metadata and stills of the app’s sketches. It makes no AI request and does not generate artwork. The full archive has more choices.
en.demo_empty: Choose an example to inspect its visual tags.
en.code_title: A sketch is a set of drawing rules.
en.code_text: p5.js draws into a canvas. A setup function prepares the scene; a draw loop can redraw it over time or respond to input. That is why a preview can move, change with your pointer, or react to a camera or microphone.
en.code_note: The archive previews are written in the project. The final synthesis requests new code from OpenAI. Names in the archive are creative starting points, not a substitute for an art-history course.
en.workflow_title: From browsing to an HTML artwork.
steps: Scroll into the grid. Hover on desktop or select on touch. Choose one to three anchors; tap a selected entry again to remove it.

Use Generate Art to submit the selected styles. Read the interpretation and answer the follow-up question. The server’s current prompts request Chinese analysis and artwork descriptions, even with the English interface.
Use the arrows to move between the generated works. Camera and audio variants may ask for device access. The pure generative mode does not require either device.
Download saves the currently displayed artwork as an HTML file, including its code, title and description. Open it in a browser to run it again.
captions: The live archive’s opening screen. The background is chosen from saved HTML artworks.
Three selected anchors and their real p5 previews.
en.runtime: Exploring and choosing built-in styles runs in your browser. Analysis and synthesis use the app’s server-side OpenAI service; visitors do not need to enter an API key. Selected style metadata and your written response are sent for those requests.
limits: This flow keeps selections and generated results in memory. Reloading or initializing a new session clears them. Export before leaving.
An HTML file still needs its libraries
The export includes the sketch but loads p5.js, p5.sound and ml5 from external CDNs. It is a portable HTML artwork, not a fully offline package. Browser device permissions still apply.
A model may produce code that fails or behaves differently across browsers. On an AI service failure the app labels an offline example; that example is not a successful personalized generation.
en.local_note: For local AI, configure the server-only OPENAI_API_KEY in .env.local. Never put the key in a VITE_ variable or the introduction.
en.footer: A Frankie project by Songhai Fan

zh.headline:
探索一种风格。
创造一种新的。
zh.intro: 选择视觉锚点，思考它们的联系，再把你的回应变成一幅运行中的 p5.js 作品。
zh.hero_caption: 当前档案界面，已选中三个真实风格预览。
zh.concept: 档案中的每种风格都是一段绘图程序，而不是固定图片。鼠标悬停时会出现动态预览。选择一至三个吸引你的风格，开始下一步。
features: 每个条目都包含风格名称和视觉标签。所选名称与标签会成为下一阶段的创作素材。
OpenAI 返回诗意的审美原型、简短解读和一个追问。这是创作提示，不是心理测评或诊断。
你的回答与所选风格用于请求三个 p5.js 作品：纯生成作品、摄像头响应作品，以及音频响应作品。
zh.demo_intro: 锚点就是你选中的风格。试选下面三个例子，查看应用实际使用的名称和视觉标签。
zh.demo_note: 这个小演示复用真实档案元数据与应用绘图程序的静态画面，不请求 AI，也不生成作品。完整档案提供更多选择。
zh.demo_empty: 选择一个例子，查看它的视觉标签。
zh.code_text: p5.js 在画布上绘图。setup 准备场景，draw 循环随时间重绘，也可以响应输入。因此预览可以移动、跟随指针，或者响应摄像头与麦克风。
zh.code_note: 档案预览由项目中的程序绘制；最后的创作阶段则向 OpenAI 请求新代码。档案名称是创意起点，不等同于完整的艺术史课程。
zh.workflow_title: 从浏览到导出 HTML 作品。
steps: 向下进入风格网格。桌面端悬停预览，触屏直接选择。选一至三个锚点，再次点击已选条目即可移除。
点击 Generate Art 提交所选风格。阅读解读并回答追问。当前服务端提示要求中文解读和作品说明，即使界面切换为英文也一样。
用箭头切换生成作品。摄像头和音频响应版本可能请求设备权限；纯生成模式不需要这两种设备。
下载按钮把当前展示作品的代码、标题和说明保存为 HTML 文件，可用浏览器再次运行。
zh.gallery_title: 当前档案里的真实界面。
captions: 实时档案的开场。背景从已保存的 HTML 作品中随机选择。
三个已选锚点及其真实 p5 预览。
zh.runtime: 内置风格的浏览和选择在浏览器运行。解读与生成使用服务端的 OpenAI，访客无需输入 API key。请求时会发送所选风格的元数据，以及你输入的回应。
limits: 选择与生成结果保存在当前页面的内存中。刷新或开始新一轮会清空它们，离开前请先导出。
导出包含作品代码，但 p5.js、p5.sound 与 ml5 仍从外部 CDN 加载。它是便携的 HTML 作品，不是完整离线包；设备访问仍受浏览器权限控制。
生成代码可能存在差异
模型生成的代码可能失败，或在不同浏览器中表现不同。AI 服务失败时，应用会标明正在展示离线示例；示例不代表个性化生成成功。
zh.local_note: 本地 AI 需在 .env.local 配置仅供服务端使用的 OPENAI_API_KEY。不要使用 VITE_ 前缀，也不要把 key 放进介绍页。
zh.footer: Songhai Fan 的 Frankie 系列项目
